title: Intellectual Property Protection of Hyperdimensional Computing Classifiers: Black-Box Ownership Verification via Model Watermarking
abstract: arXiv:2610.34942v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyperdimensional computing (HDC) offers efficient learning and inference for resource-constrained systems, yet ownership verification of its models remains underexplored. We present the first systematic investigation of model watermarking in HDC by adapting backdoor-based embedding to three classifiers with different prototype-learning mechanisms. Across four benchmarks, with conventional neural networks as references, we examine whether watermarks can be learned without compromising task accuracy and whether they survive subsequent model modification and replication. The error-driven classifiers, AdaptHD and OnlineHD, support verification at a nominal trigger exposure of 1% with at most 0.58 percentage points of mean accuracy loss, whereas single-pass Vanilla HDC requires greater exposure and can incur substantial accuracy costs. translated_title: 超维计算分类器的知识产权保护：基于模型水印的黑盒所有权验证
translated_abstract: 超维计算为资源受限系统提供了高效的学习与推理能力，但其模型的所有权验证仍未得到充分探索。我们通过将基于后门的嵌入方法应用于三种具有不同原型学习机制的分类器，首次对超维计算中的模型水印技术进行了系统性研究。在四个基准数据集上，以传统神经网络作为参照，我们研究了水印能否在不损害任务准确率的情况下被学习，以及水印能否在后续的模型修改和复制中存活。基于误差驱动的分类器AdaptHD和OnlineHD在名义触发样本暴露率仅为1%的情况下即可支持验证，平均准确率损失最多为0.58个百分点，而单次遍历的Vanilla HDC则需要更高的暴露率，并可能带来显著的准确率损失。基于误差驱动的模型在原生持续训练下仍能保持验证能力，但模型提取会产出替代……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 本文首次系统研究了超维计算（HDC）分类器的模型水印技术，通过基于后门的嵌入方法实现黑盒所有权验证，发现误差驱动分类器（AdaptHD和OnlineHD）在仅1%触发样本暴露下即可完成验证且平均准确率损失不超过0.58个百分点，而单次遍历的Vanilla HDC则需要更高暴露率并可能造成较大准确率损失。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic investigation of model watermarking for hyperdimensional computing classifiers, enabling black-box ownership verification via backdoor-based embedding, showing that error-driven classifiers (AdaptHD and OnlineHD) achieve verification with only 1% trigger exposure and at most 0.58 percentage points of mean accuracy loss, whereas single-pass Vanilla HDC requires greater exposure and may incur substantial accuracy costs.
